text.WLC: אָ֭הַבְתִּי כִּֽי יִשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֑ה אֶת ק֝וֹלִ֗י תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
text.SYN: Хвалите Господа, все народы, прославляйте Его, все племена;
text.NEO: Je l’aime, car Yahweh entend ma voix, mes supplications.
text.NAB: I love the LORD, who listened to my voice in supplication,
text.VAT_ES: Amo al Señor, porque él escucha
text.CEI: Alleluia. Amo il Signore perché ascolta il grido della mia preghiera.
text.LXX: Ἁλληλουιά. Ἠγάπησα ὅτι εἰσακούσεται ὁ θεὸς τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου,
text.VUL: Alleluja. Dilexi, quoniam exaudiet Dominus vocem orationis meæ.
text.DRA: I have loved, because the Lord will hear the voice of my prayer.

text.WLC: כִּֽי הִטָּ֣ה אָזְנ֣וֹ לִ֑י וּבְיָמַ֥י אֶקְרָֽא׃
text.SYN: ибо велика милость Его к нам, и истина Господня [пребывает] вовек. Аллилуия.
text.NEO: Car il a incliné vers moi son oreille, et toute ma vie, je l’invoquerai.
text.NAB: Who turned an ear to me on the day I called.
text.VAT_ES: porque inclina su oído hacia mí,
text.CEI: Verso di me ha teso l'orecchio nel giorno in cui lo invocavo.
text.LXX: ὅτι ἔκλινεν τὸ οὖς αὐτοῦ ἐμοί, καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ ἐπεκαλεσάμην.
text.VUL: Quia inclinavit aurem suam mihi, et in diebus meis invocabo.
text.DRA: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me: and in my days I will call upon him.

text.WLC: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי חֶבְלֵי מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא׃
text.NEO: Les liens de la mort m’entouraient, et les angoisses du schéol m’avaient saisi ; j’étais en proie à la détresse et à l’affliction.
text.NAB: I was caught by the cords of death; the snares of Sheol had seized me; I felt agony and dread.
text.VAT_ES: Los lazos de la muerte me envolvieron,
text.CEI: Mi stringevano funi di morte, ero preso nei lacci degli inferi. Mi opprimevano tristezza e angoscia
text.LXX: περιέσχον με ὠδῖνες θανάτου, κίνδυνοι ᾅδου εὕροσάν με· θλίψιν καὶ ὀδύνην εὗρον.
text.VUL: Circumdederunt me dolores mortis ; et pericula inferni invenerunt me. Tribulationem et dolorem inveni,
text.DRA: The sorrows of death have encompassed me: and the perils of hell have found me. I met with trouble and sorrow:

text.WLC: וּבְשֵֽׁם יְהוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
text.NEO: Et j’ai invoqué le nom de Yahweh : « Yahweh, sauve mon âme ! »
text.NAB: Then I called on the name of the LORD, "O LORD, save my life!"
text.CEI: e ho invocato il nome del Signore: "Ti prego, Signore, salvami".
text.LXX: καὶ τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου ἐπεκαλεσάμην Ὦ Κύριε, ῥῦσαι τὴν ψυχήν μου.
text.VUL: et nomen Domini invocavi : o Domine, libera animam meam.
text.DRA: And I called upon the name of the Lord. O Lord, deliver my soul.

text.NEO: Yahweh est miséricordieux et juste, notre Dieu est compatissant.
text.NAB: Gracious is the LORD and just; yes, our God is merciful.
text.VAT_ES: El Señor es justo y bondadoso,
text.CEI: Buono e giusto è il Signore, il nostro Dio è misericordioso.
text.LXX: ἐλεήμων καὶ δίκαιος ὁ κύριος, καὶ Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐλεᾷ.
text.VUL: Misericors Dominus et justus, et Deus noster miseretur.
text.DRA: The Lord is merciful and just, and our God sheweth mercy.

text.WLC: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לּוֹתִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
text.NEO: Yahweh garde les faibles ; j’étais malheureux, et il m’a sauvé.
text.NAB: The LORD protects the simple; I was helpless, but God saved me.
text.VAT_ES: el Señor protege a los sencillos:
text.CEI: Il Signore protegge gli umili: ero misero ed egli mi ha salvato.
text.LXX: φυλάσσων τὰ νήπια ὁ κύριος· ἐταπεινώθην, καὶ ἔσωσέν με.
text.VUL: Custodiens parvulos Dominus ; humiliatus sum, et liberavit me.
text.DRA: The Lord is the keeper of little ones: I was little and he delivered me.

text.WLC: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי יְ֝הוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי׃
text.NEO: Mon âme, retourne à ton repos ; car Yahweh te comble de biens.
text.NAB: Return, my soul, to your rest; the LORD has been good to you.
text.CEI: Ritorna, anima mia, alla tua pace, poiché il Signore ti ha beneficato;
text.LXX: ἐπίστρεψον, ἡ ψυχή μου, εἰς τὴν ἀνάπαυσίν σου, ὅτι Κύριος εὐηργέτησέν σε·
text.VUL: Convertere, anima mea, in requiem tuam, quia Dominus benefecit tibi :
text.DRA: Turn, O my soul, into thy rest: for the Lord hath been bountiful to thee.

text.WLC: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת עֵינִ֥י מִן דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי׃
text.NEO: Oui, tu as sauvé mon âme de la mort, mon œil des larmes, mes pieds de la chute.
text.NAB: For my soul has been freed from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
text.VAT_ES: El libró mi vida de la muerte,
text.CEI: egli mi ha sottratto dalla morte, ha liberato i miei occhi dalle lacrime, ha preservato i miei piedi dalla caduta.
text.LXX: ὅτι ἐξείλατο τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ θανάτου, τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου ἀπὸ δακρύων, καὶ τοὺς πόδας μου ἀπὸ ὀλισθήματος.
text.VUL: quia eripuit animam meam de morte, oculos meos a lacrimis, pedes meos a lapsu.
text.DRA: For he hath delivered my soul from death: my eyes from tears, my feet from falling.

text.NEO: Je marcherai encore devant Yahweh, dans la terre des vivants.
text.NAB: I shall walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
text.VAT_ES: Yo caminaré en la presencia del Señor,
text.CEI: Camminerò alla presenza del Signore sulla terra dei viventi.
text.DRA: I will please the Lord in the land of the living.
